task_posting.description: Organization posts a task to the labor marketplace
task_posting.justification: Creates demand for workers. The fee enables the worker payment.

crisis_routing_api.description: External system uses SolarPunk's crisis routing API
crisis_routing_api.goes_to: 100% crisis pool (the routing call IS a donation)
crisis_routing_api.justification: The API call itself routes money to Gaza/Sudan/DRC/Yemen. Fee = donation.

bulk_verification.justification: Verification services have real compute cost.

agent_api_access.description: AI agents use SolarPunk APIs — FREE, but...
agent_api_access.optional_contribution: Agent can optionally route 0.1% of their revenue through SolarPunk crisis routing
agent_api_access.model: Value exchange, not charity: agent gets humanitarian routing capability, SolarPunk gets mission fulfilled
agent_api_access.justification: AI agents routing ANY revenue through us multiplies impact.

swarm_build_request.description: Agents contribute code to Distributed Forge
swarm_build_request.justification: Swarm code has real value. We accept it as currency.

payment_links.note: Add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY secret to activate live payment links

crisis_routing_1k_per_day.scenario: 1000 external crisis routing calls per day

conservative_combined.scenario: 5 task posts + 500 API calls + 2 bulk verifications per day

crisis_routing.description: Route funds to crisis organizations (PCRF, IRC, MSF, UNICEF)
crisis_routing.fee: 0.001 USD per call — goes 100% to crisis pool

labor_marketplace.description: Post task to SolarPunk labor marketplace
labor_marketplace.note: Workers earning from tasks always free — fee only for task posters

impact_proof.fee: Free — public data, no auth required
impact_proof.returns: SHA256-verified bundle of all impact events

worker_verification.fee: Free for individual verifications, 5 USD for batch

print_relay.description: Dispatch 3D printed part to crisis region
print_relay.restrictions: Crisis zones only, verified need required

philosophy: Workers always free. Orgs pay. Revenue funds wages + crisis routing.
